body:
Source: GitHub issues #705 and #706 (bug, P1-high, class false-green) and #709 (bug, security, P1-high, class trust boundary). Re-verified on main @ a627e4ac.

DEFECT A (#705) — packages/parallax/lib/modes.mjs:86-87. `const agreements = divergenceResult.agreements ?? [];` / `const divergences = divergenceResult.divergences ?? [];`. runDivergenceAnalysis accepts whatever the mid-tier divergence call returns as long as extractJson parses SOMETHING. If the model returns JSON lacking both expected keys — a refusal object, a truncated `{}`, a bare array, a wrapper like `{"result": …}` — both `??` defaults fire, both lists are empty, and computeScore(0, 0) returns 0 by design (packages/parallax/lib/scoring.mjs:14 `if (total === 0) return 0;`). Score 0 <= the default threshold 0.25, so bin/parallax.mjs calls `pass()` and exits 0, printing `_(no clear agreements found across readings)_`, `_(none — all readings converged)_` and `gate PASSES ✓`. Nothing anywhere distinguishes "the readings converged" from "the analysis produced nothing measurable". `--questions-json` makes it machine-consumable: the empty divergence list becomes `{questions: [], gate: true}`, and docs/interrogation-protocol.md's stopping condition is "The loop ends when the frontier is empty" — so a P1 interrogation loop reads that payload as "nothing to ask the human" and stops.

DEFECT B (#706) — packages/parallax/lib/modes.mjs:75. `if (readings.length < 2) {`. parseFanResults pushes every failed call and every parse failure into `errors` and continues; the only floor is an ABSOLUTE 2, not one relative to `--n`. Run with `--n 5`, have three calls fail (rate limit, timeout, off-schema JSON), and the tool proceeds to a full verdict computed from 2 readings and emits `gate: true/false` as if the requested fan had run, with the three failures parked in a `warnings` array. Sampling diversity is this tool's entire instrument, so a silently narrowed fan yields a systematically LOWER ambiguity score — i.e. it biases toward exit 0. Neither `--json` (bin/parallax.mjs:189, :334) nor `--questions-json` (:187, :332) carries the effective fan width; none of the plugin commands that call parallax inspect `warnings`. Separately, `--n 1` passes argument validation (bin:85 `if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) opError('--n must be a positive integer')`) but can never produce a verdict: the fan runs, one API call is spent, and the >=2 guard then exits 1.

DEFECT C (#709) — packages/parallax/bin/parallax.mjs:132. `const entry = recordVerdict({ verdict, extra, key: getKey() });` passes no `ticket`, and parseArgs (bin:62-81) declares no `--ticket` option at all. `lib/verdict.mjs:57` already accepts a `ticket` parameter that nothing ever supplies, so `record()` omits the field and the manifest entry is unbound. The sibling tools resolved this deliberately: premortem's help text says `--record-verdict … Requires --ticket — an unbound record can satisfy any ticket's P1 gate`, and coldstart derives `const ticket = runAll ? undefined : targets[0].id;`. The P0/P1 flow (plugins/adlc-claude-code/commands/adlc-spec.md) already resolves a ticket id before invoking parallax.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/parallax` (an npm workspace). Modules: `bin/parallax.mjs` (arg parse, the three modes — spec / edge (`--edge`) / route (`--route`) — output rendering and the pass()/gateFail()/opError() exits); `lib/modes.mjs` (fan(), parseFanResults(), runDivergenceAnalysis(), runSpecMode(), runEdgeMode(), runRouteMode()); `lib/scoring.mjs` (computeScore, renderReport, renderQuestionsJson); `lib/prompts.mjs` (prompt builders); `lib/verdict.mjs` (recordVerdict — already accepts `ticket`, needs no change). Tests: `npm test -w packages/parallax` from the worktree root, or `node scripts/run-tests.mjs parallax`. Existing tests that are NOT rails and MAY be changed: `test/modes.test.mjs`, `test/args.test.mjs`, `test/questions-json.test.mjs`, `test/scoring.test.mjs`.

CRITICAL CONSUMER CONSTRAINT — read before designing. parallax is one of the model-calling packages in the cross-package conformance gate `scripts/test/flag-consistency.test.mjs`, whose parallax entry (:64-69) invokes the bin with `['--request', 'example feature request']` plus `--prompt-only` / `--tier`. `--prompt-only` must keep exiting 0 with zero network calls, and the new `--n` floor must not reject its default. Also check `scripts/test/adlc-spec-parallax-mode.test.mjs` and `scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs`, which pin how the plugin commands and the router describe this tool; and `plugins/adlc-pi/lib/gate-policy.mjs` plus `plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/gate-tool.mjs`, which name parallax in their argv policies. Run all of these before claiming green.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. `lib/modes.mjs` gains ONE exported pure validator used by every path that consumes a divergence payload: `export function divergencePayloadError(result)` returning a reason string when the payload is unusable, or `null` when it is usable. Unusable means: not a non-null object, or `Array.isArray(result.agreements)` is false, or `Array.isArray(result.divergences)` is false. Reason text names what was expected, e.g. `divergence analysis returned an off-schema payload (expected {agreements:[…], divergences:[…]})`.
2. `runDivergenceAnalysis` calls it immediately after `extractJson` and THROWS with that reason when non-null. The `?? []` defaults at :86-87 are removed — after the validator both fields are known arrays. bin/parallax.mjs already wraps the mode call in a try/catch that routes to `opError` (exit 1), so an off-schema payload becomes an operational error, never a score. computeScore must be unreachable from the live path with total 0.
3. Fan width becomes part of the contract. `runDivergenceAnalysis` returns `requested` (the `n` it was asked for) and `used` (`readings.length`) alongside its existing fields, and `runSpecMode` / `runEdgeMode` / `runRouteMode` pass them through. A shrunken fan refuses a verdict: when `used < requested` and the new `--allow-partial-fan` flag was NOT given, throw with a reason naming both numbers and the errors, e.g. `fan shrank to <used> of <requested> requested readings; refusing a verdict (pass --allow-partial-fan to accept a narrowed sample). Errors: …` — which the bin surfaces as opError (exit 1). With `--allow-partial-fan`, proceed exactly as today and keep the existing `warnings` behaviour. The absolute `readings.length < 2` floor stays as the innermost guard and keeps its current message.
4. `bin/parallax.mjs` adds `'allow-partial-fan': { type: 'boolean', default: false }` and threads it into every mode call. Both `--json` and `--questions-json` payloads gain `requested` and `used` in ALL THREE modes (spec, edge, route). `warnings` stays where it is.
5. `--n` floor: reject `--n 1` at parse time. The message becomes `--n must be an integer >= 2 (a divergence analysis needs at least two readings to compare)`; exit 1 via the existing opError. The default of 3 is unchanged.
6. `--ticket <id>` is added to parseArgs and threaded into `recordVerdict({ ticket, verdict, extra, key: getKey() })`. Following premortem, `--record-verdict` REQUIRES `--ticket`: without it, opError (exit 1) with a message stating that an unbound record can satisfy any ticket's P1 gate. `--ticket` on its own (no `--record-verdict`) is accepted and ignored. The `--help`/USAGE text documents both, mirroring premortem's wording. `lib/verdict.mjs` needs no change.
7. Regression guard, must keep behaving exactly as today: `--prompt-only` prints prompts and exits 0 with zero network calls; a well-formed divergence payload with a score above threshold still gateFails (exit 2) and below still passes (exit 0); the markdown report text for a genuinely converged reading set is unchanged; `warnings` remains present.
8. Documentation: describe the off-schema refusal, `--allow-partial-fan` with `requested`/`used`, the `--n >= 2` floor and `--ticket` in `packages/parallax/README.md`, and make the SAME edits by hand in `docs/tools/parallax.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/parallax.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A divergence payload of `{}`, `[]`, `{"error":"…"}` or `{"result":{}}` makes runDivergenceAnalysis throw and the bin exit 1 — never score 0 and never `gate PASSES`. verify: `node --test packages/parallax/test/fan-integrity.test.mjs`
- AC2 A well-formed payload with empty-but-present arrays still scores 0 and passes (a genuine convergence is not an error). verify: `node --test packages/parallax/test/fan-integrity.test.mjs`
- AC3 `divergencePayloadError` is exported, pure, and the only place the schema condition is spelled. verify: `node --test packages/parallax/test/fan-integrity.test.mjs`
- AC4 With `--n 5` and 3 failed readings, no verdict is emitted (exit 1) and the message names 2 of 5; with `--allow-partial-fan` the verdict is emitted and `used`/`requested` report 2 and 5. verify: `node --test packages/parallax/test/fan-integrity.test.mjs`
- AC5 `--json` and `--questions-json` carry `requested` and `used` in spec, edge and route modes. verify: `node --test packages/parallax/test/questions-json.test.mjs`
- AC6 `--n 1` is rejected at parse time with the new message and spends no API call; `--n 2` and the default 3 are accepted. verify: `node --test packages/parallax/test/args.test.mjs`
- AC7 `--record-verdict` without `--ticket` exits 1 and records nothing; with `--ticket T1` the recorded entry carries the ticket. verify: `node --test packages/parallax/test/fan-integrity.test.mjs`
- AC8 Existing package suite green. verify: `npm test -w packages/parallax`
- AC9 The named consumer suites are green. verify: `node --test scripts/test/flag-consistency.test.mjs scripts/test/adlc-spec-parallax-mode.test.mjs scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs`
- AC10 Docs updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c allow-partial-fan packages/parallax/README.md docs/tools/parallax.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/parallax.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC11 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: changing computeScore's formula or the 0.25 default threshold; changing the prompt builders in lib/prompts.mjs; making parallax's verdict entry a required P1 gate input; touching premortem or coldstart.
title: parallax: refuse a verdict from an off-schema divergence payload or a shrunken fan, and bind --record-verdict to a ticket
